title: 2026 SAVA Gelaro S8 GRX820 carbon gravel bike
notes: Current exact-model manufacturer page identifies the 2026 R21-GRX820-12S as a T800 carbon frame and fork with full internal routing, Shimano GRX RX820/RX822 1x12, approximately 10.2 kg complete weight excluding pedals, 700x40C fitted tires and 45C maximum compatibility. Size, other accessories and weighing method are not stated. The page describes additional carbon reinforcement at the head tube, bottom bracket and rear dropouts but does not publish the lay-up schedule or molding process. A duplicated lower-page RX810 label conflicts with the main exact specification and is not merged. The US$2,199 direct price is not a mainland CNY checkout observation.
